# Upstream Microduck license texts

These verbatim texts come from
[pollen-robotics/microduck_rl](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl/tree/bae39f5900b318f7e87fc485c30a31213cfa14eb),
revision `bae39f5900b318f7e87fc485c30a31213cfa14eb`.

The file patterns and “this repository” wording in these texts refer to that
upstream repository. They cover its Microduck material and any corresponding
copies in `site/`; other demo dependencies retain their own licenses.

- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Apache-2.0 for the upstream code, XML and configurations.
- [LICENSE-MODELS.md](LICENSE-MODELS.md): CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the listed STL meshes.

No upstream payload is included in this scaffold. Mesh redistribution remains
subject to the repository owner's decision, attribution and modification notices.
